Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed Supplier/Tenderer as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender
Data Sheet (TDS) of the Tender Document.
a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Supplier/Tenderer in the electro-mechanical works shall be five (05)
years.
b) The minimum specific experience of the Supplier/Tenderer at least 01 (One) contract of similar nature of works (Internal
Electrification and Fire Fighting Works of Building Construction) successfully completed within the last five (5) years (Years/Date
counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the e-GP system) with a value of at least Tk. 9.00 (Nine) Crore only
Government/ Semi-Government/ Autonomous Bodies /Private within Bangladesh. The issued Private Certificate must be
authenticated (verified) by the Executive Engineer of PWD within his jurisdiction.
c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Letter of Commitment for Bank’s Undertaking for line of Credit as
per Form PG3-8 of Tender and Contract Forms must be submitted for this Purpose of the successful Tenderer shall not be less
than Tk. 10.00 Crore only. The Supporting Bank Document submitted along with the Tender must be issued in between
Publication date & Submission date of the Tender.
d) Supplier/Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC category Contractory License (License must be issued in favour of his own
organization) & Electrical Supervisory Certificate from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing Board.
